_comment: The base label vocabulary: how a block renders, for a label no model speaks about specifically. What a model says about its own labels lives with the model, in resources/profiles/models/<id>.json (roles.ocr.blocks.styles) — see docs/10-model-profiles.md. Styles: text | heading | image | italic | equation | table. A heading may pin its level with {"style": "heading", "level": 2}. Unmapped labels render as plain text. Changing a mapping here needs no rebuild; a malformed or missing file falls back to the table compiled into src/parsers/BlockStyle.cpp.
